description: Khorula wears a full-length dark blue patterned gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold-tan woven borders decorate the neckline, bodice, sleeves and hem. A cream patterned underlayer appears along the skirt opening and cuffs. A richly woven belt with two round metal clasps defines the waist. A matching dark blue and gold bordered wrap rests along her arms, with fringed ends hanging to the lower skirt. A round pendant and small earrings provide restrained jewelry. Brown closed shoes are visible beneath the hem. Fabrics appear substantial and opaque; exact fibers cannot be identified. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
